title: Take care, Mallworld friends
content: Hope, everyone has good Mallworld dreams. I'm going to take a break for a while don't know when I'll be back. Got to get my dream/meditative groove back. I've enjoyed reading everyone's experiences and plan to be back at some point. Just want to give my mind a reset to have it flourish in my world for awhile. I'm routing for all of you, in your explorations. Keep dreaming my friends. See you guys again.
